程序包 org.bukkit.inventory

接口 MenuType.Typed<V extends InventoryView,B extends InventoryViewBuilder<V>>

类型参数:
V - 代表视图类型的 InventoryView 的泛型类型

原文：the generic type of InventoryView that represents the view type.

B - 代表视图构建器的 InventoryViewBuilder 的构建器类型
所有超级接口:
FeatureDependant, net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed, Keyed, MenuType
封闭接口:
MenuType
public static interface MenuType.Typed<V extends InventoryView,B extends InventoryViewBuilder<V>> extends MenuType
Typed 代表 MenuType 的一个子类型, 在编译时具有已知的 InventoryView 类型.

原文： Typed represents a subtype of MenuTypes that have a known InventoryView type at compile time.

  • 方法详细资料

    • create

      default V create(HumanEntity player)
      Creates a view of the specified menu type.

      The player provided to create this view must be the player the view is opened for. See HumanEntity.openInventory(InventoryView) for more information.

      参数:
      player - the player the view belongs to
      返回:
      the created InventoryView

    • create

      @Deprecated(since="1.21") V create(HumanEntity player, @Nullable java.lang.String title)
      已过时。
      Use create(HumanEntity, Component) instead.
      创建指定菜单类型的视图.

      提供给此方法创建视图的玩家必须是该视图所打开的玩家. 详见 HumanEntity.openInventory(InventoryView).

      原文： Creates a view of the specified menu type.

      The player provided to create this view must be the player the view is opened for. See HumanEntity.openInventory(InventoryView) for more information.

      参数:
      player - 视图所属的玩家

      原文：the player the view belongs to

      title - 视图的标题

      原文：the title of the view

      返回:
      创建的 InventoryView

      原文：the created InventoryView
